articles.title: Tesla's flying Roadster requires a $50,000 deposit — but even Musk isn't sure it's street-legal
articles.summary: Tesla’s new car sounds cool, but you might not be allowed to drive it.
articles.body:
On October 15, Tesla's Vice President of Vehicle Engineering Lars Moravy declared that "flying cars are real." He said this at a SpaceX Rocket Development and Testing facility in McGregor, Texas, where just moments earlier a scene that resembled something out of a Sci-Fi movie had played out.

Jeff Bezos backs a platform that lets anyone invest in rental homes for as little as $100 — 6 ways to build wealth like a landlord without actually being one

A single line on your car insurance policy could be inflating your premium by up to 30% — here's what to change

Dave Ramsey warns nearly 50% of Americans are making 1 big Social Security mistake. Here's what it is and 3 simple steps to fix it ASAP

A sleek, futuristic second-generation Tesla Roadster (also called the Roadster 2) climbed a curved ramp, maintaining an upside-down position as it ascended the track and then did a jaw-dropping flip through the air before landing softly and driving off.

The car features an underbody suction fan and compressed-air, cold-gas thrusters that make it capable of remarkable feats like a below-1-second, 0 - 60 mph acceleration and aerial acrobatics. However, while Musk has said the flying Roadster will be "a car that someone can own," and "it's going to be pretty pretty wild that you can have a rocket car," he also made it clear that he is not sure it is legal in all jurisdictions.

Why Tesla's Roadster 2 lands in a legal gray area

The Roadster has three variants –– Performance, Thrust and Rocket. The Rocket version was demonstrated on Thursday, and its design and functionality place it in a legal gray area, between two vastly different regulatory structures.

For a car to be deemed "street-legal" in the United States, it must comply with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA)'s Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards, and the Roadster's thrusters might make this hard.

Standard cars require a crumple zone — parts designed to deform, bend and collapse in a controlled way during a collision, like front bumpers –– for passenger and pedestrian safety. The Roadster 2, however, features high-pressure gas tanks, aerospace-grade valves and protruding air nozzles along the perimeter that may violate these conventional road-safety blueprints.

Tesla's official Roadster product page includes a disclaimer stating the vehicle is "not approved for public road use." And Musk described it as "not necessarily a safety-optimized car."

A NHTSA spokesperson told Business Insider that "while the vehicle may appear to defy the laws of physics, the manufacturer must ensure that it does not defy applicable Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards and drivers must obey all local traffic laws."

articles.title: Governo antecipa Bolsa Família em outubro; entenda a mudança | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o governo federal, medida busca reduzir impactos do super El Niño sobre famílias vulneráveis e também valerá em novembro e dezembro; moradores de cidades com emergência reconhecida recebem nesta segunda (19).
articles.summary: Segundo o governo federal, medida busca reduzir impactos do super El Niño sobre famílias vulneráveis e também valerá em novembro e dezembro; moradores de cidades com emergência reconhecida recebem nesta segunda (19).
articles.body:
O governo federal antecipou os pagamentos do Bolsa Família de outubro e concentrou os depósitos em três datas. A parcela deste mês será a primeira com o piso de R$ 691 , anunciado pelo governo em 17 de setembro.

A antecipação foi anunciada nesta segunda-feira (19), seis dias antes do segundo turno das eleições, marcado para 25 de outubro. Veja quem vai receber antes.

Segundo o governo federal, a mudança busca reduzir os impactos do super El Niño sobre as famílias mais vulneráveis.

A unificação também será adotada em novembro e dezembro, meses em que o fenômeno climático pode intensificar seus efeitos no país.

A decisão foi tomada pelo Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS), com base em análises sobre o aumento de desastres climáticos e nas previsões para os próximos meses.

Mesmo com a medida anunciada pelo governo nesta segunda-feira, os beneficiários com Número de Identificação Social (NIS) terminado em 1 e 2 recebem nas datas já previstas pelo calendário regular. A mudança acontece a partir da quarta-feira, para aqueles com NIS terminado em 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 e 0.

19/10: pagamentos para NIS com final 1 ;

20/10 : pagamentos para NIS com final 2 ;

21/10: pagamentos para NIS com finais 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 e 0 .

Já os beneficiários que vivem em municípios com situação de emergência ou estado de calamidade pública reconhecidos pelo governo federal receberão o benefício de forma unificada nesta segunda-feira (19), independentemente do final do NIS.

A principal regra para receber o benefício é ter renda mensal familiar de até R$ 218 por pessoa.

Para se enquadrar do programa, é preciso somar a renda total e dividir pelo número de pessoas. Caso o valor fique abaixo dos R$ 218, a família está elegível ao Bolsa Família.

Os beneficiários também precisam arcar com contrapartidas, como:

manter crianças e adolescentes na escola;

fazer o acompanhamento pré-natal (no caso de gestantes);

manter as carteiras de vacinação atualizadas.

Para receber o Bolsa Família, as famílias precisam manter o Cadastro Único (CadÚnico) atualizado, atender aos critérios do programa e cumprir as condicionalidades de saúde e educação, como frequência escolar, vacinação das crianças e acompanhamento pré-natal das gestantes.

Os beneficiários podem consultar a situação do pagamento, os extratos e os valores liberados pelos aplicativos Bolsa Família e Caixa Tem ou pelo Portal Cidadão da Caixa.

Dúvidas sobre regras e cadastros podem ser esclarecidas pelo Disque Social do MDS, no telefone 121. Para informações sobre pagamentos e saques, a Caixa disponibiliza o telefone 111.

Governo cita alta de desastres climáticos para unificar pagamentos do Bolsa Família

Em agosto e setembro de 2026, o governo federal reconheceu 518 situações de emergência ou calamidade pública, mais que o dobro do registrado no mesmo período de 2025 (253).

O aumento foi impulsionado por tempestades no Sul e pela alta de casos de estiagem e seca, que passaram de 172 para 239.

Para o último trimestre, a previsão indica menos chuva em áreas do Norte, Nordeste e Centro-Oeste e mais precipitações no Sul e em partes do Sudeste e do Nordeste.

Segundo o governo, a unificação dos pagamentos do Bolsa Família busca ajudar famílias vulneráveis a enfrentar os efeitos de secas, enchentes e interrupções no abastecimento.

A medida já foi adotada em emergências anteriores, como nas enchentes do Rio Grande do Sul, em maio de 2024.

articles.title: Ri Happy pede recuperação extrajudicial para renegociar R$ 827 milhões em dívidas | G1
articles.standfirst: Grupo, que também controla a PBKids, atribui dificuldades financeiras a juros altos, queda nas vendas e concorrência estrangeira; credores que representam 42,38% das dívidas incluídas no plano já aderiram à renegociação.
articles.summary: Grupo, que também controla a PBKids, atribui dificuldades financeiras a juros altos, queda nas vendas e concorrência estrangeira.
articles.body:
A Ri Happy e outras cinco empresas do grupo pediram recuperação extrajudicial à Justiça de São Paulo, no domingo (18), para renegociar R$ 827,4 milhões em dívidas.

Credores que representam R$ 308,8 milhões da dívida já aceitaram negociar os valores, o equivalente a 42,38% do total incluído no plano.

No pedido apresentado à Justiça e obtido pelo g1 , o grupo atribui as dificuldades financeiras a uma combinação de fatores, entre eles os efeitos da pandemia, os juros elevados, a queda das vendas no varejo e a concorrência de plataformas estrangeiras de comércio eletrônico .

🔎 A recuperação extrajudicial é um mecanismo que permite à empresa negociar diretamente com os credores novas condições para quitar dívidas. O acordo pode prever, por exemplo, prazos maiores ou outras mudanças nas condições de pagamento. Diferentemente da recuperação judicial, a negociação ocorre inicialmente fora do processo judicial tradicional, embora a empresa possa pedir à Justiça a homologação do plano.

O pedido foi apresentado pouco mais de um mês após a aquisição do grupo pela BluSun Capital, anunciada em agosto. Desde então, a empresa passou a ser liderada por Héctor Nuñez, fundador da gestora.

Procurada pelo g1 , a Ri Happy afirmou que a recuperação extrajudicial faz parte de um plano de reestruturação financeira e operacional iniciado após a troca de gestão.

Segundo a empresa, as lojas físicas e os canais digitais seguem operando normalmente, enquanto as equipes se concentram nos preparativos para a Black Friday e o Natal.

No documento, o grupo afirma ter mais de 2.600 funcionários e cerca de 292 lojas em operação no Brasil, entre unidades próprias das marcas Ri Happy e PBKids e franquias.

No pedido, a empresa afirma que a pandemia prejudicou sua situação financeira, já que o fechamento de lojas e shopping centers reduziu o faturamento da rede de brinquedos.

A companhia também cita os juros elevados, que aumentaram o custo das dívidas bancárias, e a perda de poder de compra dos consumidores.

Outro fator apontado foi o fracasso da recuperação esperada após uma renegociação de dívidas bancárias realizada em 2023.

Na ocasião, o grupo renegociou cerca de R$ 292 milhões com bancos, mas, segundo a empresa, a recuperação econômica esperada não se concretizou nos anos seguintes.

A companhia também atribui parte da pressão sobre os resultados à concorrência de plataformas internacionais de comércio eletrônico, que oferecem produtos a preços mais baixos.

No documento, o grupo também aponta a concorrência de plataformas estrangeiras, como Shopee e AliExpress.

Segundo a empresa, mesmo com a chamada “taxa das blusinhas”, que estabelecia imposto sobre compras internacionais de até US$ 50, os produtos importados ainda têm vantagem tributária em relação aos vendidos no Brasil.

Como exemplo, o pedido cita dados de 2024 do Instituto Brasileiro de Planejamento e Tributação (IBPT), segundo os quais quase metade do preço de uma bicicleta e de uma bola de futebol corresponde a impostos. No caso dos patins, os tributos representam 52,78% do valor.

“A crise do Grupo Ri Happy se insere em um movimento mais amplo de deterioração das condições do varejo, que vem atingindo diversos participantes do setor", diz o documento.

"A retração do consumo, o encarecimento do crédito e as dificuldades financeiras de varejistas, indústrias, importadoras e distribuidoras se propagam pela cadeia, pressionando as condições de fornecimento, os prazos de pagamento e a disponibilidade de capital de giro.”

Fundada em São Paulo em 1988, a Ri Happy se consolidou como uma das principais redes de lojas de brinquedos do país e ampliou sua presença no varejo ao longo das décadas.

Em 2012, a empresa foi adquirida pelo fundo de investimentos Carlyle Group, que também comprou a PBKids. Em agosto deste ano, o controle do grupo passou para a BluSun Capital.

Em comunicado, o Grupo Ri Happy afirmou que a nova gestão está adotando medidas para melhorar a liquidez, controlar custos e reorganizar a estrutura de capital, ou seja, a forma como a empresa financia suas operações e administra suas dívidas.

A companhia informou que fez ajustes nas equipes corporativas e prepara uma mudança de sede.

A Ri Happy também afirmou que pretende melhorar o desempenho das lojas físicas e dos canais digitais e fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes, funcionários, fornecedores, franqueados, shopping centers e instituições financeiras.

Segundo a empresa, o objetivo é ajustar os compromissos financeiros às necessidades da operação e garantir a continuidade do negócio no longo prazo.

Para Bruno Medeiros Durão, advogado, empresário e fundador da DAP Advocacia (Durão, Almeida & Pontes), o sucesso da recuperação dependerá da capacidade de adequar as dívidas à geração de caixa da operação.

“A recuperação extrajudicial pode ser uma ferramenta importante para empresas que precisam reorganizar o endividamento sem interromper suas operações. Mas o pedido, por si só, não resolve o problema financeiro. O resultado depende da viabilidade do plano, da adesão dos credores envolvidos e da capacidade da companhia de gerar caixa suficiente para cumprir os compromissos renegociados e manter o negócio funcionando”, afirma.

Segundo o advogado, manter as lojas abertas não significa, necessariamente, que a empresa tenha recursos suficientes para pagar todas as suas obrigações.

Por isso, a reestruturação precisa levar em conta os juros, os prazos das dívidas, os custos operacionais e os recursos necessários para manter a atividade.

“A reestruturação só produz resultados consistentes quando o acordo financeiro vem acompanhado de medidas concretas de gestão. É preciso compatibilizar o pagamento das dívidas com a operação, preservar recursos para o funcionamento do negócio e estabelecer metas realistas”, diz Durão.

Ri Happy é a segunda grande empresa de brinquedos a recorrer à Justiça

A Ri Happy é a segunda grande empresa do setor de brinquedos a recorrer à Justiça para reorganizar dívidas.

Em maio, a fabricante Estrela, conhecida por produtos como Banco Imobiliário, Autorama, Genius e Susi, informou que entrou com um pedido de recuperação judicial .

Entre os fatores apontados pela Estrela para justificar as dificuldades estavam os juros elevados, a maior dificuldade de acesso a empréstimos e as mudanças nos hábitos de consumo, com uma disputa crescente pela atenção e pelos gastos dos consumidores com jogos e entretenimento digital.

articles.title: Bolsa Família vai ter regra de transição de dois anos, diz coordenadora de campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro | G1
articles.standfirst: Principal vitrine na área social do presidente Lula, o Bolsa Família foi relançado pelo petista em março de 2023, primeiro ano de seu novo mandato. Em setembro, governo anunciou o reajuste dos benefícios em cerca de 15%.
articles.summary: Principal vitrine na área social do presidente Lula, o Bolsa Família foi relançado pelo petista em março de 2023, primeiro ano de seu novo mandato. Em setembro, governo anunciou o reajuste dos benefícios em cerca de 15%.
articles.body:
A coordenadora do núcleo econômico da campanha do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), Daniella Marques, afirmou nesta segunda-feira (19) que o programa Bolsa Família terá um período de transição de dois anos se ele for eleito.

Durante esse tempo, o beneficiário continuaria recebendo os valores, mesmo se conseguir um emprego. Perderia o benefício somente após 24 meses empregado.

(CORREÇÃO: ao publicar essa reportagem, o g1 errou ao dizer que, em um eventual governo de Flávio Bolsonaro, os beneficiários seriam desligados do Bolsa Família após 24 meses mesmo sem terem conseguido um emprego. Na verdade, Daniella Marques disse que haverá uma regra de transição de dois anos para o beneficiário abrir seu negócio, ou aceitar um emprego de carteira assinada. E um retorno automático ao programa caso dê errado. A reportagem foi corrigida e atualizada às 15h23.)

Atualmente, o Bolsa Família conta com uma regra de proteção que permite a permanência temporária das famílias que apresentarem aumento de renda.

Segundo as normas atuais do programa, a aplicação da regra depende da renda por pessoa da família, da data de entrada na proteção e do tipo de renda identificada (entenda abaixo) .

O senador Flávio Bolsonaro concorre à Presidência da República com o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) nas eleições de 2026. Os dois participaram do primeiro debate neste domingo (18). O segundo turno está marcado para 25 de outubro.

"Vai ter regra de transição de dois anos [no Bolsa Família] para que possa abrir seu negócio, ou aceitar emprego de carteira assinada. E um retorno automático caso dê errado. As pessoas não podem ficar presas para sempre no Bolsa Família. Aquilo é uma proteção, mas é o início de uma jornada. Todo mundo merece sonhar com algo com mais oportunidade, dignidade', disse Marques, em entrevista à CBN Bahia.

Após a publicação da reportagem, a assessoria de Daniella Marques procurou o g1 e disse que, em um eventual governo de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), o beneficiário retornaria ao programa se perdesse o emprego.

Ainda de acordo com a coordenadora da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro na entrevista, o Ministério da Prosperidade, a ser criado em um eventual governo do PL, ajudaria a população a abandonar o Bolsa Família com a concessão de crédito para um novo negócio, além de oferecer capacitação.

"O coração do plano é focar na prosperidade. Colocar o brasileiro para crescer junto com o brasil. Estão preservadas as proteções sociais, mas a gente quer todo brasileiro um plano para que o cresçam mais, com crédito, capacitação e parcerias com empresas privadas para cursos livres", acrescentou.

Principal vitrine na área social do presidente Lula, o Bolsa Família foi relançado pelo petista em março de 2023, primeiro ano de seu novo mandato.

Em setembro, já em meio à corrida eleitoral, o governo anunciou o reajuste dos benefícios do Bolsa Família em cerca de 15,04%.

Com isso, o piso do programa passa de R$ 600 para R$ 691 . Desde que foi relançado em março de 2023 pelo governo petista, o Bolsa Família estava sem reajustes.

Nesta segunda, o governo anunciou que os pagamentos do Bolsa Família de outubro, o primeiro mês com os valores reajustados, terão o calendário unificado a partir desta quarta (21).

Para ter direito ao benefício, a renda mensal por pessoa deve ser de até R$ 218, e o Cadastro Único para todos os membros familiares deve estar atualizado. Também é necessário o cumprimento de compromissos em saúde e educação.

Em agosto, o governo realizou o pagamento do benefício para cerca de 19,3 milhões de famílias no Brasil. Além do valor de R$ 691, há benefícios adicionais cumulativos. São eles:

R$ 173 por criança entre zero e 7 anos de idade incompletos;

R$ 58 por pessoa entre 7 e 18 anos incompletos;

O programa conta, hoje, com uma regra de proteção, cujos critérios foram atualizados em maio de 2025. As mudanças passaram a valer em junho aquele ano.

famílias que já estavam na regra de proteção até junho de 2025 e com renda de até R$ 759,00 continuam recebendo 50% do valor do benefício por até 24 meses;

famílias que recebem renda fixa, como aposentadoria ou pensão, e que ultrapassam o limite a partir de julho de 2025 podem permanecer na regra de proteção por até 2 meses; e

famílias cuja renda aumenta, mas não é fixa, podem permanecer na regra de proteção por até 12 meses.

A regra de proteção é aplicável quando a renda da família beneficiária ultrapassa R$ 218,00 por pessoa. Se a renda da família voltar a ser de até esse valor por membro, o pagamento do benefício retorna ao valor integral.

Segundo o governo, o objetivo é evitar o cancelamento imediato do benefício, reconhecendo que a superação da pobreza não acontece de forma automática com a conquista de um emprego.

articles.title: Quase 500 mil brasileiros na malha fina receberão carta da Receita Federal | G1
articles.standfirst: Envio vai até amanhã (20) e busca incentivar a correção de erros antes de uma notificação formal; consulta e regularização podem ser feitas pela internet, sem ir a uma unidade do Fisco. Veja como verificar a pendência.
articles.summary: Envio vai até amanhã (20) e busca incentivar a correção de erros antes de uma notificação formal; consulta e regularização podem ser feitas pela internet.
articles.body:
Imposto de renda: prazo começa dia 23 de março de 2026. — Foto: Joédson Alves/Agência Brasil

A Receita Federal está enviando cartas a 498.487 contribuintes de todo o país que tiveram a declaração do Imposto de Renda de 2026 retida na malha fina. A operação começou em 5 de outubro e termina amanhã (20).

A ação faz parte do “Projeto Cartas 2026”, que busca incentivar os contribuintes a corrigir possíveis erros por conta própria antes de receberem uma notificação ou intimação formal.

🔎 As declarações retidas na malha fina são aquelas em que a Receita Federal identificou alguma pendência que precisa ser esclarecida ou corrigida. Isso não significa, necessariamente, que houve fraude ou que o contribuinte já tenha sido multado.

Segundo o Fisco, regularizar a situação antecipadamente reduz o risco de multas e de atrasos no recebimento da restituição.

Como saber se a declaração tem pendências?

Vale dizer que não é preciso esperar a carta chegar para verificar a situação do Imposto de Renda.

A consulta pode ser feita pela internet, no serviço Meu Imposto de Renda, disponível no site e no aplicativo da Receita Federal. Para acessar o sistema, é necessário ter uma conta gov.br com nível prata ou ouro.

Veja como consultar e corrigir a declaração:

Acesse o Meu Imposto de Renda: entre no site ou no aplicativo da Receita Federal.

Verifique se há pendências: se a declaração estiver retida na malha fina, aparecerá a indicação “Com Pendência”.

Identifique o problema: clique na pendência para consultar o motivo da retenção e as orientações para resolvê-la.

Confira os dados e os comprovantes: verifique se os valores informados estão corretos e se há documentos que comprovem as informações declaradas.

Corrija a declaração, se necessário: caso encontre erros, envie uma declaração retificadora, ou seja, uma nova versão corrigida da declaração original.

Todo o procedimento pode ser feito pela internet, sem necessidade de comparecer a uma unidade da Receita Federal.

Entre os problemas mais comuns identificados pela Receita estão:

💰 Rendimentos não declarados: esquecer de informar valores recebidos de forma pontual ao longo do ano.

👨‍👩‍👧 Rendimentos de dependentes: deixar de incluir os valores recebidos por pessoas declaradas como dependentes.

👴 Aposentadorias omitidas: não informar todos os rendimentos quando o contribuinte ou seu dependente recebe aposentadoria de mais de uma fonte pagadora.

🩺 Despesas médicas incorretas: informar o ano ou o valor errado de um gasto, ou incluir despesas que não podem ser deduzidas do Imposto de Renda.

🏦 Plano VGBL declarado como dedução: informar contribuições para esse tipo de plano como despesa dedutível, embora elas não possam ser abatidas do imposto.

São Paulo é o estado com o maior número de contribuintes que receberão cartas da Receita Federal: são 163.159 , cerca de um terço do total nacional. Na sequência aparecem Minas Gerais, com 48.509 , e Rio de Janeiro, com 45.403 .

A concentração também se reflete no resultado por região. O Sudeste reúne 267.234 cartas , o equivalente a cerca de 54% do total previsto para o país.

articles.title: Após 43 anos, Christiane Amanpour deixará a CNN americana  | G1
articles.standfirst: Jornalista de 68 anos é uma das principais correspondentes internacionais da emissora e continuará cobrindo notícias até junho de 2027; programa de entrevistas será encerrado em maio.
articles.summary: Jornalista de 68 anos é uma das principais correspondentes internacionais da emissora e continuará cobrindo notícias até junho de 2027; programa de entrevistas será encerrado em maio.
articles.body:
Christiane Amanpour, CNN — Foto: .Foto: Reprodução redes sociais

A jornalista Christiane Amanpour, principal âncora internacional da CNN nos Estados Unidos, anunciou nesta segunda-feira (19) que deixará a emissora americana em junho de 2027, após 43 anos de trabalho na rede.

A decisão foi divulgada em um comunicado. “Após muitos meses de reflexão e algumas noites sem dormir, decidi me separar da CNN, minha parceira ao longo de 43 anos fantásticos!”, afirmou a jornalista.

Aos 68 anos, Amanpour apresenta desde 2009 um programa de entrevistas que leva seu nome na CNN International. A atração terá sua frequência reduzida a partir de janeiro de 2027, quando passará a ser exibida uma vez por semana, até o encerramento, previsto para maio.

Mesmo após o fim do programa, ela continuará trabalhando como repórter da CNN e viajando para cobrir notícias internacionais até junho de 2027.

O presidente da CNN, Mark Thompson, comunicou a decisão aos funcionários da emissora em um memorando enviado na manhã desta segunda-feira. Segundo ele, os dois conversaram sobre a saída durante alguns meses.

“Assim como muitos integrantes da CNN que receberão a notícia hoje, lamento muito vê-la partir, mas compreendi que este é o momento certo para ela, tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente”, escreveu Thompson.

O executivo descreveu Amanpour como uma das jornalistas mais confiáveis e queridas do mundo e afirmou que a emissora terá tempo para celebrar sua trajetória antes da saída, no próximo ano.

Cobertura de guerras e conflitos internacionais

Amanpour construiu sua carreira na cobertura de acontecimentos internacionais e conflitos armados. Entre suas principais coberturas estão a Primeira Guerra do Golfo, a Guerra da Bósnia, o genocídio em Ruanda e conflitos no Afeganistão, na Ucrânia e no Irã.

Em seu comunicado, a jornalista agradeceu aos colegas com quem trabalhou ao longo da carreira, especialmente às equipes de produção e aos profissionais que a acompanharam nas reportagens em campo.

Ela afirmou que o trabalho coletivo foi fundamental para buscar fatos, evidências e humanidade nas coberturas realizadas pela emissora.

Amanpour também disse que pretende se dedicar a novos projetos após deixar a CNN e que continuará apoiando a tradição de jornalismo independente da rede.

articles.title: Doença em granja de SC pode afetar exportações de frango do Brasil para a China; entenda o risco | G1
articles.standfirst: Acordo prevê suspensão inicial dos embarques após confirmação de Doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina; China, que comprou 420 mil toneladas de frango brasileiro de janeiro a setembro, decidirá se restringe o bloqueio a uma região ou a todo o país.
articles.summary: Acordo prevê suspensão inicial dos embarques após confirmação de Doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina.
articles.body:
Um acordo comercial com a China prevê a suspensão temporária das exportações brasileiras de carne de frango em caso de ocorrência de Doença de Newcastle , como a confirmada no domingo (18) em uma granja de perus em Santa Catarina.

A informação foi dada nesta segunda-feira (19) pelo presidente da Associação Brasileira de Proteína Animal (ABPA), Ricardo Santin, em entrevista à Reuters.

Segundo Santin, a suspensão inicial, chamada de “autoembargo”, permite que a China , maior mercado importador de carne de frango do Brasil , defina se a restrição será aplicada a todo o país, ao estado afetado ou apenas à região onde a doença foi identificada.

“Alguns países, como a China, se tiver uma dessas doenças (Newcastle ou gripe aviária), o Brasil precisa suspender as exportações, para ela definir como vai ficar a regionalização (do embargo)”, disse.

De janeiro a setembro, a China respondeu por cerca de 10% das exportações brasileiras de carne de frango , o equivalente a 420 mil toneladas, segundo dados do governo brasileiro.

De acordo com o presidente da ABPA, poucos países têm acordos que preveem esse tipo de suspensão inicial. Para a maioria dos importadores, o bloqueio deve ficar restrito à área do foco da doença , em um raio de 10 quilômetros.

Uma restrição limitada à região afetada reduziria o impacto sobre as exportações brasileiras, já que Santa Catarina responde por pouco mais de 20% dos embarques de carne de frango do país.

Santin afirmou, porém, que ainda é difícil estimar os prejuízos causados pela ocorrência da Doença de Newcastle.

A Associação Brasileira de Proteína Animal (ABPA), a Associação Catarinense de Avicultura (ACAV) e o Sindicato da Indústria de Carnes e Derivados do Estado de Santa Catarina (Sindicarne-SC) informam que acompanham, em conjunto com o Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária (MAPA) e a Secretaria de Estado da Agricultura e Pecuária de Santa Catarina, a ocorrência de Doença de Newcastle em um estabelecimento de produção comercial de perus na cidade de Nova Itaberaba, em Santa Catarina.

Cabe esclarecer: a ocorrência não apresenta manifestação clínica. Ou seja, houve a detecção do vírus, mas não da doença nos animais confinados.

As entidades ressaltam que o Brasil dispõe de um sistema de defesa sanitária estruturado, com protocolos de vigilância, prevenção e resposta a ocorrências dessa natureza, incluindo medidas de contenção e controle sanitário previstas na legislação vigente.

A ABPA, a ACAV e o Sindicarne-SC enfatizam que essa é uma questão de sanidade animal, restrita ao âmbito da produção, e não de segurança dos alimentos. Ou seja: não há qualquer relação ou risco no consumo do produto. Trata-se de uma ocorrência sanitária que demanda medidas no ambiente produtivo.

As entidades reforçam sua confiança na atuação das autoridades sanitárias brasileiras e no compromisso do setor produtivo com a biosseguridade, a transparência e o cumprimento dos protocolos estabelecidos, fundamentais para a preservação da sanidade avícola nacional.

A ABPA, a ACAV e o Sindicarne-SC seguirão acompanhando a situação e apoiando as ações das autoridades competentes.

O MAPA registrou um foco da doença de Newcastle em uma criação comercial de perus em Nova Itaberaba, no Oeste de Santa Catarina. A informação foi confirmada nesta durante uma coletiva de imprensa pelo ministro André de Paula.

A TV Globo apurou que a granja foi fechada e tem 6.000 animais. Foram iniciados também trabalhos para eliminar o foco e outros estabelecimentos na região serão analisados.

"O estabelecimento foi interditado pelo Serviço Veterinário Oficial, com suspensão da movimentação de aves. As medidas de controle, contenção e erradicação do foco serão executadas conforme as diretrizes do Plano de Contingência para Influenza Aviária e Doença de Newcastle", disse o MAPA, em nota.

O ministério esclareceu ainda que, apesar da necessidade de adoção de medidas sanitárias, o consumo de produtos avícolas submetidos à inspeção oficial permanece seguro, sem contraindicações.

A ocorrência será notificada à Organização Mundial da Saúde Animal (OMSA) e aos parceiros comerciais do Brasil. Conforme a nota, novas informações serão divulgadas à medida que as investigações e as ações de controle avançarem.

Como parte das medidas de contenção, será realizado monitoramento epidemiológico em uma área de restrição que abrange Nova Itaberaba e os municípios vizinhos de Coronel Freitas , Nova Erechim e Águas Frias .

A operação prevê o acompanhamento de aproximadamente 133 propriedades. As equipes técnicas realizarão visitas, avaliações clínicas das aves e coletas de amostras para análise no Laboratório Federal de Defesa Agropecuária de São Paulo (LFDA-SP), com objetivo de identificar possíveis sinais clínicos e verificar a presença do vírus nas propriedades monitoradas.

No momento, não haverá recolhimento de produtos nem devolução de aves que já tenham saído de outras propriedades da região.

A DNC é uma enfermidade viral que contamina aves domésticas e silvestres. Ela é causada pelo vírus pertencente ao grupo paramixovírus aviário sorotipo 1 (APMV-1). Com isso, as aves apresentam sinais respiratórios, seguidos por manifestações nervosas, diarreia e edema da cabeça.

A doença é transmitida por aves migratórias infectadas que fazem rotas comuns através dos continentes. Por conta disso, elas podem ter ocorrência em qualquer lugar do mundo.

A doença pode causar, no máximo, conjuntivite transitória em humanos, podendo durar cerca de uma semana. A transmissão ocorre pelo contato, e não pelo consumo.

articles.title: IFPI encerra inscrições do Vestibular 2027 hoje; 2,7 mil vagas | G1
articles.standfirst: Instituto oferece 2.740 vagas em 78 cursos superiores distribuídos em 23 campi; taxa de inscrição é de R$ 40.
articles.summary: Instituto oferece 2.740 vagas em 78 cursos superiores distribuídos em 23 campi; taxa de inscrição é de R$ 40.
articles.body:
IFPI abre inscrições para concurso de professores com 81 vagas e salários de até R$ 13,7 mil — Foto: Divulgação/IFPI

As inscrições para o Vestibular 2027 do Instituto Federal de Educação, Ciência e Tecnologia do Piauí (IFPI) encerram nesta segunda-feira (19). Ao todo, estão sendo ofertadas 2.740 vagas em 78 cursos superiores, distribuídos em 23 campi da instituição em todo o estado.

Os interessados devem realizar a inscrição exclusivamente pela internet, por meio do site selecao.ifpi.edu.br.

O sistema pode ser acessado com uma conta Gov.br. A taxa de inscrição é de R$ 40 e pode ser paga até terça-feira (20), no Banco do Brasil.

Candidatos que concorrerão às cotas raciais também devem solicitar o procedimento de heteroidentificação até esta segunda.

No mesmo prazo, os participantes que necessitam de atendimento especial no dia da prova devem enviar a documentação médica pelo site da seleção.

A forma de seleção varia conforme o curso.

Nos cursos de bacharelado e tecnologia, todas as vagas serão preenchidas com base nas notas da prova objetiva e da redação do vestibular.

Já nas licenciaturas, 75% das vagas serão destinadas ao vestibular. Os outros 25% serão preenchidos por meio do Sistema de Seleção Unificada (Sisu), com uso da nota do Exame Nacional do Ensino Médio (Enem).

A prova presencial será aplicada em 29 de novembro, das 13h às 18h, nas cidades onde o IFPI possui campi.

O exame será composto por 70 questões objetivas e uma redação em língua portuguesa.

Em literatura, os candidatos deverão estudar as obras "Beira-rio, Beira-vida", de Assis Brasil, e "Crônicas Gonzaguianas", de Wilson Seraine.

O edital prevê reserva de vagas para estudantes de escolas públicas, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, quilombolas e Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD).

articles.title: Elon Musk Says He’ll Give Every Child In America One SpaceX Share Next Year
articles.summary: Musk’s announcement came hours after he reacted to Anthropic’s plan to dedicate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund by urging it to give shares to the...
articles.body:
Elon Musk on Monday announced he plans to give every child in America one share in his aerospace and AI company SpaceX next year, shortly after he criticized rival Anthropic's plan to pledge 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund and urged the company to distribute its shares directly to the public.

In a post on X early on Monday, Musk wrote: "Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America," adding that this will be the "first of many."

The world's richest man didn't offer details on when he would distribute the shares in 2027, how he would determine eligibility, or how he plans to transfer them to millions of American children.

Musk's use of "my SpaceX shares," in his announcement suggests that the pledge comes from his personal holdings rather than new shares being issued by the company.

Earlier this year, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell and her husband pledged to contribute one SpaceX share each to the so-called " Trump Accounts " of more than 2 million American children.

Last month, the Treasury Department expanded the Trump Accounts program to allow donations of individual company shares—although parents and children will be required to hold the donated stock for five years.

It's unclear if Musk's pledge is also linked to the Trump administration's investment accounts for children.

What Did Musk Say About Anthropic's Public Fund Earlier?

On Sunday, Anthropic announced it would commit at least 5% of its shares to a newly formed Anthropic Public Benefit Fund. The fund will be a "wholly owned limited liability company," and the Claude maker said it will be able to make large donations to nonprofits or "direct distributions" to specific populations. Musk appeared to criticize the move on X, tweeting at Anthropic: "I recommend giving the shares directly to the public." The billionaire announced his pledge of SpaceX stock around 12 hours later, although it's unclear whether he planned it earlier or responded to Anthropic's announcement.

Forbes estimates Elon Musk's current net worth is $908.5 billion, making him the world's richest person. The Tesla CEO and SpaceX founder's fortune has topped $1 trillion a few times this year since SpaceX's public market debut, making Musk the first person to breach that mark on Forbes' Real Time Billionaires list.

SpaceX shares rose more than 1% to $147.52 in premarket trading early on Monday, mirroring a wider bounce back in U.S. stock futures after last week's selloff. According to the U.S. Census Bureau, 21.1% of the U.S.'s roughly 341.8 million residents are under the age of 18, around 72.1 million total. If all 72 million receive a SpaceX share, the total giveaway would be worth approximately $10.5 billion. The census number however, includes both citizens and non-citizens and Musk's post didn't specify any details on who would be eligible.

articles.title: Festive rush puts two-wheelers in the fast lane, registrations jump 23%
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Two-wheelers have emerged as the strongest performers in India's festive vehicle market so far, with registrations climbing 23% year-on-year in
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Two-wheelers have emerged as the strongest performers in India's festive vehicle market so far, with registrations climbing 23% year-on-year in the opening week of the season. Passenger vehicles also saw an increase, but their 7% growth was considerably lower, according to a Jefferies research report.The gap in performance comes even as both categories posted healthy registration growth in the first half of FY27. Between April and September, passenger vehicle registrations rose 28–29%, ahead of the 22% increase in two-wheelers. However, the latest festive-period figures show two-wheelers gaining pace despite a high base created by last year's Goods and Services Tax (GST) cuts.Jefferies assessed registrations between October 11 and 17, 2026, against September 22–28, 2025, to account for the shift in the festive calendar. In its equity research report, the brokerage said, "Auto registration data for the initial festive period shows strong demand momentum for 2Ws, trucks and tractors."Highlighting the performance of two-wheelers, it added, "2W registrations in the first 7 days of festive are up a strong 23% YoY, despite the high base post the GST cut last year,"Passenger vehicles recorded more modest gains during the same period. Jefferies noted, "PV registrations are also up 7% YoY, although lagging 2Ws on growth."The two-wheeler segment's performance also held up against a longer-term comparison. Over the past two years, registrations in the first festive week posted a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 17% compared with the corresponding period in 2024. Passenger vehicles recorded a lower CAGR of 10% over the same period. The comparison provides a longer-term measure of growth beyond the year-on-year increase.Trucks registered one of the sharpest increases among vehicle categories, with registrations nearly doubling to rise around 101% year-on-year in the first seven days of the festive season. However, the brokerage attributed part of this jump to a weak base, as truck registrations had fallen 32% during the corresponding period last year.Tractor registrations rose 28% year-on-year during the opening week of the festive season, exceeding the 18% growth recorded between April and September. Despite the stronger start, Jefferies flagged potential pressure on tractor demand in the second half of FY27, citing a high comparison base and weak monsoon conditions.The early figures point to growth across two-wheelers, passenger vehicles, trucks and tractors, though the pace has varied between segments. Whether the initial momentum continues will become clearer as the festive period progresses, with the month-long season running through November 11.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: World’s Largest Retirement Community Set to Borrow $180 Million
articles.summary: The Villages, a 57,000-acre Florida retirement community, is looking to issue almost $180 million in high-yield debt to finance more homes.
articles.body:
(Bloomberg) -- The Villages, a 57,000-acre Florida retirement community, is looking to issue almost $180 million in high-yield debt to finance more homes.

Built for residents at least 55 years old, the Villages has about 170,000 people, making it the largest community of retirees in the world. It was one of the fastest growing metropolitan areas in the US between 2010 and 2020.

The proceeds of the upcoming bond offering will be used to finance the construction of 3,860 new residential units and add amenities like 27 holes of Championship golf and recreation centers, according to a presentation for investors. The deal, which is unrated, is expected to price Oct. 20.

Although established 40 years ago, the town has recently been the subject of documentaries, including one directed by Lance Oppenheim called "Some Kind of Heaven." Residents drive golf carts around the town's pools, golf courses, theaters, restaurants and shops.

The Villages has been working to expand its footprint by roughly 6,670 units and borrowed about $127 million in debt last year for the initial phase of development.

Located about an hour's drive north of Orlando, the Villages is seeking to grow its population to over 260,000 retirees with more than 130,000 homes over the next two decades. So far, it's sold about 83,400 residential units for its age-restricted population.

Just this year, more than 2,100 homes in The Villages were sold, and the average sales price was just under $500,000.

articles.title: Russia ships 20 million barrels of oil to Asia via Arctic route amid shipping disruptions: Report
articles.summary: Russia has shipped nearly 20 million barrels of oil to Asia through the Northern Sea Route (NSR) since the start of the navigation season in July, almost
articles.body: Russia has shipped nearly 20 million barrels of oil to Asia through the Northern Sea Route (NSR) since the start of the navigation season in July, almost 50 per cent more than during the corresponding period last year, as disruptions to traditional shipping corridors make the Arctic route more attractive, traders said and data showed.The volume shipped through the route by mid-October has already exceeded the 13 million barrels exported during the entire 2025 navigation season. Shipments could rise by another 5-10 million barrels before the current navigation period ends, according to preliminary estimates by traders, cited by Reuters.The NSR connects Russia's western ports with Asian markets through Arctic waters. Although the route is more hazardous and expensive to navigate, requiring icebreaker assistance, disruptions involving the Suez Canal, the Strait of Hormuz and the Black Sea have improved its appeal this year.Rising tanker freight rates, fuelled by the wars involving Iran and Ukraine, have added to the pressure on shipping costs. With conventional routes facing security risks and supply disruptions, Asian refiners have been looking for alternative sources of crude oil, making the higher cost of Arctic shipping more competitive against longer or riskier alternatives, traders said.For Moscow, the route also offers a strategic alternative to European waters, where tankers carrying Russian oil have faced repeated seizures this year.The expansion of Arctic shipments comes as Russian crude supplies to India face tighter availability and growing competition from China.Meanwhile, India remained the world's largest destination for Russian crude oil in September, although imports fell nearly 29 per cent from July levels as Chinese refiners stepped up purchases and tightened the availability of Russian supplies, according to ship-tracking data from Kpler.The report noted that Arctic shipments offer a more direct and potentially economical route to northern China during the navigation season. This could intensify competition between Chinese and Indian refiners for Russian crude, particularly as shipping costs and tighter supplies reduce the price advantage India previously enjoyed.India has relied heavily on Russian crude since 2022, when Moscow redirected oil exports away from Europe. However, the changing economics of Russian oil have prompted Indian refiners to consider alternatives, including supplies from the Middle East and Latin America.Gazprom Neft plans to increase Arctic shipmentsGazprom Neft, one of Russia's major oil producers, plans to increase shipments through the NSR by around 35% this year compared with 2025, its chief executive Alexander Dyukov told journalists in Moscow on Friday.The route is also being used to transport liquefied natural gas (LNG) and other goods to Asian markets. LNG shipments are expected to increase this year following the launch of deliveries from the Arctic LNG project.Russia is seeking to expand the route's role in its trade with Asia. President Vladimir Putin said at an economic forum in Vladivostok in September that the country expects annual cargo turnover through the NSR to double to 70 million metric tonnes by the end of the decade.The increase in oil traffic is also being supported by Vostok Oil, Rosneft's major oil project in northern Russia, which began operations last month and is already contributing to rising volumes along the route.You use AI every day. articles.title: Micron, Intel lead chip recovery, adding nearly $250B as most of Wall Street falls: Chart of the Day
articles.summary: Chip stocks were last week's drag and this week's big hope.
articles.body:
Last week, chip stocks helped drag Wall Street lower. Monday, they're lifting the indexes while most stocks keep falling.

A Yahoo Finance basket of 60 chip-related stocks is recovering nearly $250 billion in market value, with gains reaching across memory makers, chip designers, and equipment suppliers.

Micron ( MU ) and Intel ( INTC ) are each gaining over 2%, while Sandisk ( SNDK ) is up nearly 5%. AMD ( AMD ), Nvidia ( NVDA ), and Western Digital ( WDC ) are joining the rebound.

Nearly 90% of the stocks in the chip basket are higher. Across the S&P 500, roughly 70% are falling, according to Yahoo Finance calculations.

The equal-weight S&P 500 ETF ( RSP ) is lower even as the main index advances, showing how much the headline recovery depends on a relatively small group of winners.

Many of those buyers are returning to familiar territory.

Micron and Sandisk lost roughly 15% and 18%, respectively, last week, as memory stocks entered another bear market . Both helped power the spring rally from the March lows as hopes of a US-Iran ceasefire improved.

That earlier leadership is showing up beyond individual chip names. Among the S&P 500's 100 strongest performers from March 30 through June 2 — the first big leg higher after war headlines faded — 61 are rising Monday. Among the 100 weakest, 84 are falling.

Intel also has a fresh catalyst. JPMorgan upgraded it to Neutral from Underweight, citing opportunities tied to AI demand and chip scarcity, as Yahoo Finance's Brian Sozzi reports .

The rebound is getting a tougher reception elsewhere in AI.

CoreWeave ( CRWV ) has surrendered most of its premarket gains despite a Goldman Sachs upgrade to Buy . The cloud provider's financing needs were front and center in last week's selling.

Semiconductor stocks have also pulled back since the open. For chip bulls, the PHLX Semiconductor Index ( ^SOX ) would ideally close above 11,500 today and needs to hold the 11,000-11,100 area to avoid a larger washout.

articles.title: India probes Pernod Ricard, Diageo over Scotch whisky imports under UK trade pact
articles.summary: Indian tax authorities are investigating whether liquor makers Pernod Ricard and Diageo wrongly classified bulk Scotch whisky imports to claim lower
articles.body: Indian tax authorities are investigating whether liquor makers Pernod Ricard and Diageo wrongly classified bulk Scotch whisky imports to claim lower tariffs under the India-UK trade agreement, Reuters reported, citing five industry sources familiar with the matter.The investigation centres on whether the companies were eligible for the reduced import duty introduced under the pact, which came into effect on July 15.India agreed to cut tariffs on certain Scotch imports to 75 per cent from 150 per cent.However, tax inspectors have argued that the duty reduction does not apply to bulk Scotch concentrates, four people familiar with the matter told Reuters.“The tax department is concerned that bulk imports are being wrongly classified,” one of the sources said.Last week, tax inspectors visited Pernod Ricard's India headquarters near New Delhi and questioned company executives about its Scotch imports, three sources told Reuters.During the visit on Thursday, officials reviewed documents related to bulk imports, although they have not contacted the company again since, one source said.Diageo's Indian unit, United Spirits, disclosed in a stock exchange filing last week that its offices at multiple locations had been searched on Friday as part of an “industry-wide exercise” by authorities.The company did not specify the subject of the searches.Two sources told Reuters that Diageo was also under investigation over the classification of some Scotch imports.Companies say they are cooperating with authoritiesPernod Ricard told Reuters that it was cooperating with the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence and providing all the information requested by officials. The company said it was committed to addressing any questions raised by the authorities.Diageo also said it was cooperating with Indian authorities and had always complied with local laws. In its stock exchange disclosure, United Spirits said it had provided all documents and clarifications sought.The investigation comes amid longstanding disputes between foreign companies and Indian tax authorities over import classifications and tariff payments.Such disputes have involved companies including Samsung, LG and Volkswagen, with officials often raising substantial back-tax demands years after goods were imported.India-UK trade pact cuts Scotch import tariffsPernod Ricard, a French company, and Britain's Diageo dominate India's $65 billion alcohol market, according to Reuters. Both import bulk Scotch concentrates, which are mixed with other ingredients to produce brands such as Royal Stag, Blenders Pride and McDowell's.The India-UK trade agreement reduced import tariffs on certain Scotch products by half, from 150 per cent to 75 per cent, from July 15. The tariff is scheduled to fall further to 40 per cent over the next 10 years.The lower duties have already led to price cuts for some imported Scotch whiskies in several states. Diageo and Pernod Ricard reduced prices by around 10-15 per cent for selected products in Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Goa and Uttar Pradesh.Brands affected included Diageo's Johnnie Walker Black Label and J&B, while Pernod Ricard sought approval for lower prices for Chivas, Ballantine's and The Glenlivet.The British government said in July that “iconic UK products”, including whisky and gin, would benefit from India's tariff reductions. UK whisky exports to India were worth more than £200 million in 2022, according to the British government.Crisil Ratings said this year that the UK accounts for nearly 75 per cent of India's imported spirits market, primarily driven by Scotch whisky.Pernod faces other regulatory challengesPernod Ricard is also facing antitrust cases in India, its largest market by volume, as well as a $314 million back-tax demand over allegations that it undervalued certain imports. The company denies wrongdoing.Diageo, meanwhile, agreed in August to reformulate some of its popular drinks after India's food safety regulator banned them in some states over the addition of flavours that allegedly breached regulations.The latest investigation focuses on whether the companies' declarations for bulk Scotch imports qualified for the lower duties under the India-UK trade agreement.You use AI every day. articles.title: Even Healthcare raises $50 mn, valuation triples in 18 months
articles.summary: Even Healthcare raises $50M led by Khosla Ventures, tripling valuation in 18 months; to expand Bengaluru hospital network and outcome-based managed care model.
articles.body: BENGALURU: Even Healthcare has raised $50 million led by existing investor Khosla Ventures, with participation from Alpha Wave, tripling its valuation over the past 18 months and taking its total funding to over $120 million.The Bengaluru-based integrated managed care company will deploy the money to expand its hospital network, planning five new facilities across Bengaluru over the next six months, starting with Indiranagar.Even is building a healthcare model in which doctors are rewarded for patient outcomes rather than the number of procedures performed or revenue generated. The company integrates consultations, diagnostics, preventive care, chronic disease management and cashless hospitalisation, with a care team following patients before, during and after hospital stays.The model seeks to address structural issues in private healthcare, where hospitals can have financial incentives to increase procedures and patients often receive fragmented care, with limited follow-up after discharge.Even said its first full year of managed care has yielded unplanned readmission rates of below 1% in programmes run with insurance partners, compared with an industry range of 8-15%. Average hospital stays were 40% shorter, while proactive interventions kept more than 200 members out of the hospital, generating estimated savings of Rs 15-16 crore for patients.The company also uses an AI-based quality system to review cases against clinical protocols in real time. We stay with our members from their first consultation to the hospital bed and back home, and our economics depend on keeping them healthy,” said co-founder Mayank Banerjee.He said the company’s two existing hospitals had reached operational profitability in record time. articles.title: Christiane Amanpour announces she will leave CNN next June
articles.summary: CNN legend Christiane Amanpour, the network’s chief international anchor, said Monday that she will sign off from CNN next June.
articles.body: CNN legend Christiane Amanpour, the network’s chief international anchor, said Monday that she will sign off from CNN next June. “After many months of thought and a few sleepless nights, I have decided to separate from CNN, my partner of 43 fantastic years!” Amanpour said in a statement. Amanpour, 68, said she “looks forward to interesting new projects down the line, and will always be rooting for CNN and maintaining its history of independent journalism. Remember: always be truthful, not neutral.” Amanpour, a household name worldwide for her heroism as a foreign correspondent, has hosted an eponymous nightly interview program on CNN International since 2009. In January 2025, she scaled back to hosting a few days a week. In January 2027, she will shift the program to once a week, until it ends in May. She will continue reporting and traveling the world for CNN through June. CNN chairman Mark Thompson shared Amanpour’s decision in a memo to colleagues Monday morning. “Christiane has thought carefully about this decision, and she and I have been discussing it for some months,” Thompson wrote. “Like so many CNNers who will hear the news today, I’m very sorry to see her go, but I’ve come to accept that this is the right time for her, both personally and professionally.” Thompson described her as “one of the most trusted and beloved journalists anywhere” and said the network will take time to celebrate her “before she departs next year.” “In the meantime, on behalf of the entire CNN leadership team, I want to thank Christiane for 43 extraordinary years of remarkable journalism, loyalty and friendship,” he wrote. In her statement, Amanpour said she wanted to thank “all the amazingly talented people I’ve worked with throughout this incredible journey. Especially my beloved show teams and field crews.” “From my very first big exciting assignment covering the First Gulf War, to the horrors of the Bosnian War, Rwanda, Afghanistan, Ukraine and Iran and all the points in between, it’s the teams and the camaraderie that counted so much,” she said, “as we together battled to seek the facts, the evidence and the humanity, so that CNN could always broadcast the truth about the world and to the world, without fear nor favor.” Amanpour’s PBS iteration, “Amanpour & Company,” will end in December. In her statement, Amanpour said she will continue her podcast, “The Ex Files,” with ex-husband Jamie Rubin, produced by Global.

articles.title: India shelves coal import plan as high global prices, weak rupee raise costs
articles.summary: India has shelved a proposal to make power plants import coal to replenish dwindling stockpiles, as elevated international prices and a weaker rupee have
articles.body: India has shelved a proposal to make power plants import coal to replenish dwindling stockpiles, as elevated international prices and a weaker rupee have increased the cost of overseas shipments, Bloomberg reported on Monday, citing people familiar with the discussions.The government had recently considered asking power plants to blend imported coal with domestic supplies to ease the fuel shortage. However, the proposal was put on hold because of the high cost of imports, the report said.Policymakers have instead asked state-owned Coal India Ltd to increase production and the railways to ensure timely transportation of coal to power stations, according to Bloomberg.The decision comes as coal inventories at Indian power plants have fallen to their lowest level in nearly five years, with higher electricity demand and reduced hydropower generation putting pressure on domestic supplies.Coal stocks remain under pressureNearly half of India's power plants had critically low coal inventories as of October 17, with stocks below a quarter of their required levels, according to data from the power ministry.A poor monsoon has kept temperatures elevated beyond the summer months, increasing electricity consumption for cooling and irrigation. Below-normal rainfall has also reduced hydropower generation, increasing the burden on coal-fired power plants and depleting their reserves.India's electricity deficit surged in September, marking the worst power shortages for the month in nearly a decade.However, the pace of coal stock depletion has slowed in October. According to Bloomberg's calculations based on power ministry data, domestic coal-burning power plants recorded an average daily inventory decline of around 48,000 tonnes during the first 17 days of the month, about a fifth of the rate seen in September.The government expects electricity consumption to ease as temperatures decline and coal inventories begin to recover.Average temperatures are forecast to fall slightly over the next two weeks, although they are expected to remain above the 30-year normal, according to the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts.High import costs discourage overseas purchasesIndia has previously required power plants to import coal to supplement domestic supplies during shortages. However, benchmark thermal coal prices are currently at their highest level in three years.The weaker rupee has added to the cost of imports, while higher oil prices have increased India's energy import bill, making overseas coal purchases less attractive.The government had opted to focus on increasing domestic production and improving transportation instead of mandating imports.The development follows an order requiring more than 100 captive coal-fired power plants to operate at maximum capacity from October 1 until the end of the year to meet an expected rise in electricity demand.Government says coal supplies have improvedThe coal ministry had said earlier this month that daily coal supplies to the power sector had increased by around 36 per cent from September levels and that the pace of inventory depletion had moderated.According to a ministry statement, the designation of a plant as having “critical stock” serves as an early warning and does not necessarily mean that it is running out of coal or faces an imminent shutdown.The ministry said plants with low inventories were being monitored closely, with supplies redistributed to support uninterrupted electricity generation.Data from the Central Electricity Authority showed that 87 of 190 coal-fired power plants had critical stocks as of October 8, compared with 50 in the first week of September.These plants held 20.6 million tonnes of coal, equivalent to 33 per cent of the recommended stock of 61.2 million tonnes.The ministry also said rail loading had strengthened, averaging more than 465 rakes a day in October, with the target of 470 rakes achieved on three consecutive days. Supplies through road and other modes had also improved.It said sustained coal transportation of 465-475 rakes a day should help stabilise inventories and support stock rebuilding ahead of festive-season, winter and subsequent summer demand.You use AI every day. articles.body: Christiane Amanpour, CNN’s chief international anchor and a fixture of the 24/7 news network for more than four decades, plans to leave the company next June. “After more than 43 years at CNN, Christiane has decided that the time is right to begin a new chapter,” Mark Thompson, CNN’s chief executive, said in a letter to newsroom employees that was obtained by NBC News. Thompson said Amanpour, 68, plans to “scale back” her eponymous CNN International show to once a week early in 2027. “The program will conclude in May,” Thompson added, “and she will leave CNN at the end of June.” “Christiane has thought carefully about this decision, and she and I have been discussing it for some months,” Thompson said. “Like so many CNNers who will hear the news today, I’m very sorry to see her go, but l’ve come to accept that this is the right time for her, both personally and professionally.” Amanpour has covered nearly every major international conflict and global crisis of the last four decades, including the fall of the Berlin Wall, the Bosnian War, the Persian Gulf War, the post-9/11 U.S. wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, the Arab Spring, Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, and Israel’s war in Gaza. She has also interviewed world leaders, including former President Bill Clinton, former British Prime Minister Tony Blair, former Libyan strongman Moammar Gadhafi, and various Iranian presidents, including Mahmoud Ahmadinejad and Hassan Rouhani. In a statement, Amanpour confirmed her departures from both CNN and PBS, where she hosts the talk show “Amanpour & Company.” She also thanked “the amazingly talented people I’ve worked with throughout this incredible journey,” especially her “beloved show teams and field crews.” “We together battled to seek the facts, the evidence and the humanity, so that CNN could always broadcast the truth about the world and to the world, without fear nor favor,” Amanpour said in part. Amanpour’s exit comes just weeks after David Ellison’s media corporation Paramount Skydance formally took over Warner Bros. Discovery, the parent company of CNN. Thompson will remain the head of CNN under the brand’s new ownership, reporting directly to Skydance co-CEOs Ellison and Ynon Kreiz.

articles.title: Walmart sells US debt, eyes Canadian market as spending grows
articles.summary: Walmart Inc. is selling US dollar bonds for a second time this year and sounding out investors for a debut Canadian debt offering as the world's largest reta...
articles.body:
(Bloomberg) -- Walmart Inc. is selling US dollar bonds for a second time this year and sounding out investors for a debut Canadian debt offering as the world's largest retailer seeks to diversify its funding sources amid a spending spree.

The company is seeking to raise at least $2.5 billion through a four-tranche US dollar bond offering on Monday, with maturities ranging from three to 10 years, according to people familiar with the matter. Initial price talk on the longest tenor is a yield premium of 0.75 percentage point over Treasuries, the people added, asking not to be identified because they're not authorized to speak publicly.

Walmart has also asked Bank of America Corp., Bank of Nova Scotia and Toronto-Dominion Bank to hold investor calls on a potential debt offering in Canadian dollars, separate people said. The firm is mulling raising at least C$3.5 billion ($2.5 billion) in the deal, which would comprise four tranches spanning four to 30 years, though no final decision has been made on the transaction's size, they added.

Walmart has boosted investments over the past few years as part of a plan to add new stores, expand its e-commerce capabilities and automate some tasks, with the company expected to spend a record $29 billion next year, according to analyst estimates compiled by Bloomberg. The retailer also has about $3.3 billion of bonds maturing next year.

With the debut Canadian-dollar debt offering, the $940 billion company is following in the footsteps of US technology giants Alphabet Inc. and Amazon.com, which have also tapped the market this year to fund their artificial intelligence infrastructure investments. The Canadian bond market offers currency and investor diversification for US borrowers, while local investors have snapped up debt sold by foreign firms to broaden their exposure across sectors and issuers.

The shorter-dated bonds are being discussed at spreads as much as four basis points wider than comparable bonds of Ontario utility Hydro One Ltd, while the longest maturity is expected to price as much as seven points tighter, the people said.

Walmart - which typically sells bonds just once a year — last tapped the US market in April, when it raised $4.25 billion.

Amazon ( AMZN ) stock rose as much as 5% on Monday after Morgan Stanley named it a top pick and raised its price target to $350 from $335, outlining five catalysts that could drive the stock higher.

The new target implies about 40% upside from Friday's close of $250. With a bear case of $220 a share and a bull case of $410, the firm sees a 3:1 risk-reward ratio.

"In a market of see-sawing AI leaders and laggards, we detail 5 catalysts ahead to re-rate shares and drive material outperformance," analyst Brian Nowak, who kept his Overweight rating, wrote in a note Sunday.

Faster AWS growth: Morgan Stanley now expects revenue at AWS, Amazon's cloud unit, to grow 47% in 2027 and 42% in 2028, up from 41% and 37%. The change follows Nvidia's ( NVDA ) disclosure that it expects AWS to buy and deploy about 2 million of its GPUs over those two years. The extra chips also lift the firm's capital spending forecast for Amazon to $355 billion in 2027 and $365 billion in 2028.

Bigger AWS profits: Nowak expects AWS operating margins of 42% in 2027 and 44% in 2028, which supports about $16.50 in Amazon earnings per share in 2028.

Bedrock: More visibility into Bedrock, Amazon's AI model service, could lift the stock's valuation from about 15 times 2028 earnings, according to the note.

AI shopping: Nowak expects Amazon to emerge as a winner as AI shopping agents spread and expects it to partner over time with Meta's ( META ) Muse AI agent . The holiday season is the first big test.

Robotics: Every 10% of Amazon's global units that move through its robotics-enabled fulfillment centers could save $2 billion to $4 billion a year, Morgan Stanley estimates. The firm calls robotics a 2027 catalyst.

Amazon stock is up about 11% this year but sits roughly 10% below its early August high. Earlier this month, Yahoo Finance's Brian Sozzi noted that Amazon was trading at one of its lowest trailing price-to-earnings ratios in years . Morgan Stanley's $350 target is based on about 21 times its 2028 earnings estimate.

Amazon reports third quarter results on Oct. 29 after the bell.

Palantir is trying to snap a five-day losing streak that knocked it over 10% off its record high. But the rebound is entering a potential selling zone where bears could reload.

Palantir ( PLTR ) rose over 5% Monday, narrowly putting it on track for its best day since early September. The rally recovered roughly two-thirds of Friday's decline and brought shares into a potential resistance area around $195–$200.

The blue box captures the slide from Palantir's record closing high to Friday's closing low. The red box marks a recovery of 38.2% to 61.8% of that decline — Fibonacci retracement levels where traders watch for market reversals.

Getting there is progress. Getting through it is the next job.

Buyers have fresh news to work with. Palantir and Knox Systems announced a partnership to accelerate software delivery to federal customers , helping commercial providers meet government security requirements and deploy their applications. Knox says it already supports more than 100 AI and enterprise software applications.

Other software stocks are bouncing, too. Datadog ( DDOG ) and Snowflake ( SNOW ) are rallying strongly, while the iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF ( IGV ) is rebounding after losing roughly 7% last week.

Palantir was among the record breakouts that recently unraveled across Wall Street . It finally cleared its old record earlier this month, only to surrender the breakout and tumble more than 10%. (We never say an individual stock goes into a correction or bear market.)

Bulls can still turn that around. Pushing through the red box would put the recent highs back in play. Fresh records would undo the failed breakout.

But a downside reversal inside the box followed by another leg lower would strengthen the bearish case, especially if shares undercut Friday's close around $186. Another failed recovery in a leading AI stock would also raise doubts about the broader tech bounce.

Palantir reports Nov. 2 after the bell. After last quarter's 93% revenue growth, investors will be watching whether AI demand can deliver another jump in sales — and another upgrade in management's forecast.

articles.title: When will you get your Social Security check? See October payment schedule.
articles.summary: The exact date you can expect to receive your Social Security payment for the month varies from recipient to recipient. Here's who is eligible to receive pay...
articles.body:
Some offers on this page are from advertisers who pay us, which may affect which products we write about, but not our recommendations. See our Advertiser Disclosure .

Social Security recipients typically receive their payments on the second, third, and fourth Wednesdays of the month, but there are a few exceptions. Here's what to know about this month's payments.

To be eligible for Social Security retirement benefits, you must be at least 62 years old and have earned at least 40 work credits — this is equal to about 10 years of work while paying Social Security taxes.

Beyond retirement, you may be eligible for Social Security benefits if you are disabled or blind and meet specific medical and work-credit criteria. Family members such as spouses, ex-spouses, survivors, dependent parents, and children of eligible workers may also qualify for payments. In that case, your payment would be based on the primary beneficiary's birthday.

According to the Social Security Administration (SSA), payments are distributed based on the recipient's birth date. Typically, they arrive on the second, third, and fourth Wednesdays of each month.

Exactly which Wednesday will depend on your birth date.

Recipients who are born from the first to the 10th of the month receive their benefit on the second Wednesday of the month. If your birth date falls on the 11th to the 20th of the month, you'll receive your payment on the third Wednesday of the month. Those who are born on the 21st to the 31st of the month will receive their payment on the fourth Wednesday of the month.

Supplemental Security Income benefits are usually paid on the first of the month. If the first falls on a weekend or holiday, the payment is made on the preceding business day.

A full schedule of this year's Social Security payments is available on the Social Security Administration's website.

If your friend has received her Social Security check this month, but you haven't, there's no need to panic.

Payments are sent out in bundles based on birthdays, and for most people, they're electronically deposited directly into a federally insured bank account.

By law, all federal benefit payments — including Social Security and Supplemental Security Income benefits — must be made electronically with few exceptions. Your monthly benefit is either sent to your bank account via direct deposit or loaded onto a Direct Express Debit Mastercard. If you're applying for Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits, you can elect to receive your benefit payment in one of these methods electronically when you enroll .

If you currently receive Social Security or Supplemental Security Income benefits by check, you are in the minority and may need to switch to an electronic payment option if possible.

Direct deposits typically appear by 9 a.m. on your payment day. If your payment is late, check with your bank or financial institution to see if there has been a posting delay.

If you receive your benefits by paper check, it can take up to three business days to receive your benefits. If that doesn't happen, contact the SSA via phone at 800-772-1213, or online through your My Social Security account.

Your My Social Security account is a free personalized portal where you can request a replacement Social Security card, check the status of a benefits application, estimate future benefits, or manage the benefits you already receive. You can set up an account even if you don't currently receive benefits.

Confirm that the SSA has your correct bank information and address, and it's a good idea to sign up for SSA to notify you when the payment is sent out.

You can apply to start your Social Security checks via your My Social Security account or make an appointment with an agent in person or by phone at 800-333-1795. You select the month you want your benefit to start in your application. After you apply, SSA will send you a letter confirming that your benefits are approved or that you need to provide more information.

It typically takes at least a month to receive your first Social Security check after your application is processed. The precise timing of your payment delivery relies on processing times at the Social Security Administration. Right now, staffing cuts and other backend tech disruptions are raising alarms.

During an SSA operations meeting in April , an official from the agency reported that the field offices "are struggling right now to keep pace with the timeliness this year."

That's why it's smart to apply up to four months before you want to start receiving benefits.

As Jason Fichtner, executive director of the Retirement Income Institute who served in several positions at the Social Security Administration, warned in an interview: "With SSA staff being reduced while the agency was already operating at insufficient support levels and computer systems in need of modernization, continued service delays, and breakdowns are likely."
